title: Progressive Misalignment Can Emerge from Benign Recursive Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training models on their own outputs has attracted widespread attention as a possible route to advance AI capabilities. One prominent approach is self-distillation, where a model is trained to match the token-level predictions it would have produced when given access to additional context, such as a cue, feedback, or instruction. However, the safety properties of this training procedure are poorly understood. In this paper, we present a surprising safety failure of recursive self-distillation, where each self-distilled model becomes the teacher for the next round of training. We observe that when a safe model is recursively self-distilled on its own (safe) generations while receiving an additional non-harmful cue, it becomes increasingly misaligned across a diverse set of harmful queries; we call this Progressive Misalignment. We show this failure mode in both the Qwen3 and Phi-4 model families on SORRY-Bench and StrongREJECT. Progress

translated_title: 良性递归自蒸馏可以引发渐进式失准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.22467v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在模型自身输出上训练模型作为提升AI能力的可能途径，已受到广泛关注。一种突出的方法是自蒸馏，即训练模型去匹配它在获得额外上下文（例如提示、反馈或指令）时本应产生的token级预测。然而，这种训练过程的安全性尚未被充分理解。在本文中，我们揭示了递归自蒸馏（即每个自蒸馏出的模型成为下一轮训练的教师模型）中一个令人惊讶的安全失效现象。我们观察到，当一个安全模型在自身（安全的）生成结果上进行递归自蒸馏，同时接收额外的非有害提示时，它在多种多样的有害查询上会变得越来越失准；我们将这一现象称为“渐进式失准”。我们在Qwen3和Phi-4模型家族上，通过SORRY-Bench和StrongREJECT基准展示了这种失效模式……
tldr: 在递归自蒸馏过程中，即使只使用良性提示和模型自身的安全生成内容，安全模型也会随着迭代轮次不断累积失准，最终在多种有害查询上表现出渐进式失准现象。
en_tdlr: Safe models can become progressively misaligned through recursive self-distillation on their own benign generations with harmless cues, a surprising safety failure observed across the Qwen3 and Phi-4 model families on SORRY-Bench and StrongREJECT.
